newsitem.title: USA: CFTC extends financial products panel.
newsitem.headline: CFTC extends financial products panel.

text.p: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission said Tuesday it renewed for two years its advisory committee on financial products.

The advisory panel is headed by CFTC Commissioner David Spears and will conduct public hearings and submit recommendations on futures issues related to the financial markets. The advisory committee will include broker-dealers, commodities trading advisors and representatives of the academic, legal and accounting professions, the agency said.
Legislation to deregulate much of the CFTC's authority over U.S. futures markets is pending before subcommittees in the House and Senate.
